passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.1
passages.text: Cur non, Mopse, boni quoniam convenimus ambo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.2
passages.text: tu calamos inflare levis, ego dicere versus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.3
passages.text: hic corylis mixtas inter consedimus ulmos?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.4
passages.text: Tu maior; tibi me est aequum parere, Menalca,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.5
passages.text: sive sub incertas zephyris motantibus umbras,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.6
passages.text: sive antro potius succedimus: aspice, ut antrum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.7
passages.text: silvestris raris sparsit labrusca racemis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.8
passages.text: Montibus in nostris solus tibi certat Amyntas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.9
passages.text: Quid, si idem certet Phoebum superare canendo?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.10
passages.text: Incipe, Mopse, prior, si quos aut Phyllidis ignes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.11
passages.text: aut Alconis habes laudes, aut iurgia Codri:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.12
passages.text: incipe, pascentis servabit Tityrus haedos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.13
passages.text: Immo haec, in viridi nuper quae cortice fagi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.14
passages.text: carmina descripsi et modulans alterna notavi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.15
passages.text: experiar, tu deinde iubeto ut certet Amyntas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.16
passages.text: Lenta salix quantum pallenti cedit olivae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.17
passages.text: puniceis humilis quantum saliunca rosetis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.18
passages.text: iudicio nostro tantum tibi cedit Amyntas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.19
passages.text: sed tu desine plura, puer; successimus antro.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.20
passages.text: Extinctum nymphae crudeli funere Daphnim

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.21
passages.text: flebant; vos coryli testes et flumina nymphis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.22
passages.text: cum complexa sui corpus miserabile nati,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.23
passages.text: atque deos atque astra vocat crudelia mater.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.24
passages.text: Non ulli pastos illis egere diebus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.25
passages.text: frigida, Daphni, boves ad flumina; nulla neque amnem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.26
passages.text: libavit quadrupes, nec graminis attigit herbam.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.27
passages.text: Daphni, tuum Poenos etiam ingemuisse leones

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.28
passages.text: interitum montesque feri silvaeque loquuntur.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.29
passages.text: Daphnis et Armenias curru subiungere tigres

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.30
passages.text: instituit; Daphnis thiasos inducere Bacchi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.31
passages.text: et foliis lentas intexere mollibus hastas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.32
passages.text: Vitis ut arboribus decori est, ut vitibus uvae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.33
passages.text: ut gregibus tauri, segetes ut pinguibus arvis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.34
passages.text: tu decus omne tuis. Postquam te fata tulerunt,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.35
passages.text: ipsa Pales agros atque ipse reliquit Apollo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.36
passages.text: Grandia saepe quibus mandavimus hordea sulcis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.37
passages.text: infelix lolium et steriles nascuntur avenae;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.38
passages.text: pro molli viola, pro purpureo narcisso,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.39
passages.text: carduus et spinis surgit paliurus acutis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.40
passages.text: Spargite humum foliis, inducite fontibus umbras,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.41
passages.text: pastores, mandat fieri sibi talia Daphnis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.42
passages.text: et tumulum facite, et tumulo superaddite carmen:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.43
passages.text: DAPHNIS EGO IN SILVIS HINC VSQUE AD SIDERA NOTVS

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.44
passages.text: FORMONSI PECORIS CVSTOS FORMONSIOR IPSE.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.45
passages.text: Tale tuum carmen nobis, divine poeta,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.46
passages.text: quale sopor fessis in gramine, quale per aestum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.47
passages.text: dulcis aquae saliente sitim restinguere rivo:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.48
passages.text: nec calamis solum aequiparas, sed voce magistrum.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.50
passages.text: Nos tamen haec quocumque modo tibi nostra vicissim

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.51
passages.text: dicemus, Daphnimque tuum tollemus ad astra;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.52
passages.text: Daphnin ad astra feremus: amavit nos quoque Daphnis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.53
passages.text: An quicquam nobis tali sit munere maius

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.54
passages.text: Et puer ipse fuit cantari dignus, et ista

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.55
passages.text: iam pridem Stimichon laudavit carmina nobis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.56
passages.text: Candidus insuetum miratur limen Olympi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.57
passages.text: sub pedibusque videt nubes et sidera Daphnis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.58
passages.text: ergo alacris silvas et cetera rura voluptas

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.59
passages.text: Panaque pastoresque tenet, Dryadasque puellas;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.60
passages.text: nec lupus insidias pecori, nec retia cervis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.61
passages.text: ulla dolum meditantur: amat bonus otia Daphnis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.62
passages.text: ipsi laetitia voces ad sidera iactant

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.63
passages.text: intonsi montes; ipsae iam carmina rupes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.64
passages.text: ipsa sonant arbusta: “Deus, deus ille, Menalca.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.65
passages.text: Sis bonus O felixque tuis! En quattuor aras:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.66
passages.text: ecce duas tibi, Daphni, duas altaria Phoebo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.67
passages.text: pocula bina novo spumantia lacte quotannis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.68
passages.text: craterasque duo statuam tibi pinguis olivi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.69
passages.text: et multo in primis hilarans convivia Baccho,—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.70
passages.text: ante focum, si frigus erit, si messis, in umbra,—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.71
passages.text: vina novum fundam calathis Ariusia nectar.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.72
passages.text: cantabunt mihi Damoetas et Lyctius Aegon;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.73
passages.text: saltantis satyros imitabitur Alphesiboeus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.74
passages.text: Haec tibi semper erunt, et cum solemnia vota

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.75
passages.text: reddemus Nymphis, et cum lustrabimus agros.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.76
passages.text: Dum iuga montis aper, fluvios dum piscis amabit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.77
passages.text: dumque thymo pascentur apes, dum rore cicadae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.78
passages.text: semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.79
passages.text: ut Baccho Cererique, tibi sic vota quotannis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.80
passages.text: agricolae facient: damnabis tu quoque votis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.81
passages.text: Quae tibi, quae tali reddam pro carmine dona?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.82
passages.text: Nam neque me tantum venientis sibilus austri,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.83
passages.text: nec percussa iuvant fluctu tam litora, nec quae

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.84
passages.text: saxosas inter decurrunt flumina valles.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.85
passages.text: Hac te nos fragili donabimus ante cicuta:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.86
passages.text: haec nos, “Formosum Corydon ardebat Alexim,”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.87
passages.text: haec eadem docuit, “Cuium pecus, an Meliboei?”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.88
passages.text: At tu sume pedum, quod, me cum saepe rogaret,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.89
passages.text: non tulit Antigenes—et erat tum dignus amari—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 5.90
passages.text: formosum paribus nodis atque aere, Menalca.
